components.name: Button
accessibility: Use Button for actions and ButtonLink for navigation.
Always provide a visible text label.
The focus ring must remain visible on every background.
Do not disable focus-visible styling.

do: Use one primary action per decision area.
Keep action labels short and explicit.
dont: Use raw hex values to recolor a variant.
Use ButtonLink for form submission.

components.name: Badge
accessibility: Badges communicate metadata, never the only indication of a critical status.

do: Use concise noun phrases.
dont: Use a badge as an interactive control.

components.name: Section
accessibility: Choose the semantic as prop that matches the document structure.

do: Use the default container for narrative page sections.
dont: Nest main landmarks.

components.name: Surface
accessibility: Surface is visual grouping only; add a landmark or heading when structure requires one.

do: Select the variant from the content role.
dont: Add arbitrary border radii in consuming code.

components.name: Eyebrow
accessibility: Eyebrow text names a real section or category and is never decorative filler.

do: Use before a heading when it improves information scent.
dont: Repeat the heading in different words.

components.name: Logo
accessibility: Decorative logo instances stay hidden from assistive technology; linked home logos require an accessible link label.

do: Select the treatment for the actual background.
dont: Stretch, recolor, rotate, or rebuild the logo.

components.name: Logo mark
accessibility: Decorative marks stay hidden from assistive technology; meaningful linked marks require an accessible link label.

do: Select the dark or light treatment for the actual background.
dont: Stretch, recolor, rotate, or rebuild the mark.
